description: TCG-assigned TPM manufacturer IDs. Key is the 4-byte ASCII id expressed as 8 hex chars (the form that appears in the EK cert's tpmManufacturer attribute, with the 'id:' prefix stripped). Values match the TCG Vendor ID Registry (https://trustedcomputinggroup.org/resource/vendor-id-registry) as of 2024-09 plus a handful of firmware-TPM / virtual-TPM IDs commonly seen in the wild.
source: TCG Vendor ID Registry, plus /drivers/char/tpm/tpm-chip.c in the Linux kernel tree.

414D4400.name: AMD
414D4400.notes: fTPM inside AMD PSP firmware. Weaker than a discrete TPM: compromise of the PSP compromises the TPM. Known CVEs: CVE-2021-26355 (fTPM arbitrary code exec).

414E5400.name: Ant Group
414E5400.notes: TCG vendor code ANT; used by a handful of Chinese server boards.

41544D4C.name: Atmel
41544D4C.notes: Acquired by Microchip Technology. AT97SC3204 series.

4353434F.name: Cisco
4353434F.notes: Shipped as part of Cisco UCS platforms.

48495349.name: HiSilicon
48495349.notes: TPM IP for HiSilicon Kunpeng series.

48505100.name: HPE
48505100.notes: HPE / HP TPMs on ProLiant / EliteBook platforms.

49424D00.name: IBM
49424D00.notes: IBM SW TPM and System z hardware TPM.

49465800.name: Infineon
49465800.notes: Infineon SLB 9665 / SLB 9670 / SLB 9672. The most common discrete TPM in consumer laptops (Lenovo ThinkPad, Dell Latitude, HP EliteBook). Root CA: OptigaRsaRootCA (URL in vendor docs).

494E5443.name: Intel
494E5443.notes: Intel Platform Trust Technology (PTT) — fTPM implemented inside the CSME. Weaker than discrete: compromise of CSME compromises the TPM. Known-bad: CVE-2019-0090.

4E545A00.name: Nationz Technologies
4E545A00.notes: Chinese TPM vendor; common on Nationz-branded Chinese boards.

4E544300.name: Nuvoton Technology
4E544300.notes: NPCT650/750 series. Common on Lenovo, ASUS, MSI consumer boards and some enterprise laptops. Ships its own root CA; widely deployed.

534D4643.name: SMF Creative Technology
534D4643.notes: Less common; found on some embedded Chinese boards.

534D4E4E.name: Samsung
534D4E4E.notes: Samsung TrustZone-backed fTPM on some Exynos platforms.

53544D20.name: STMicroelectronics
53544D20.notes: ST33TPHF2E series. Common on Dell / Framework / HP laptops. Publishes root CA on www.st.com.

57454300.name: Winbond
57454300.notes: Acquired by Nuvoton; older WPCT301 series.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.notes: The tpmManufacturer attribute on the EK cert did not match any TCG-assigned vendor ID in our database. This could mean a new vendor ID has been registered since this release was cut, or the cert is synthetic / from a virtual TPM that does not populate the attribute.
